about_the_game:
AMMUNITION

The moment you descend from the sky, the fate of the battle rests in your hands. Astrovoid’s weapon crate offers you not only explosive power but also sniper scopes, silent suppressors, destructive lasers, and much more. Use the points you've earned to make your choice; every touch will change the course of the war. Strengthen your weapon or sell your old equipment to create new legends—it's entirely up to you. A true Astrovoid warrior wisely uses their arsenal and builds the path to freedom with the power of their gear!

WARRIOR

In Astrovoid, you’ll fight to survive in dangerous missions with your team. Whether you move as a small unit or a large squad, every decision will shape the outcome of the war.

Remember, the enemies are ruthless, and the darkness of space shows no mercy. Keep an eye on your teammates; a wrong move could harm a friend, but true victory can only be achieved through flawless teamwork!

CRUSHERS

Astrovoid’s greatest threats are not ordinary foes but deadly bosses, the true masters of the battlefield. Each one can change the course of the war with unique attack patterns and ruthless tactics.

Facing them takes courage, but the rewards are great. Plan your strategy, move as a team, and by defeating the most dangerous enemies, become a true legend. In Astrovoid, survival requires not just firepower, but brains and endurance!

FINAL ESCAPE

The mission is complete, but the real battle begins now! The enemies are on your tail, time is running out, and you have only one goal: reach the escape point.

Call the spaceship, set up a defense line, and fight for survival in the final battle. But remember, if some don’t make it, the ones left behind will face their fate.

In Astrovoid, victory is not just about winning the battle but surviving it!

content_descriptors.notes: Includes realistic violence, blood, and brutality involving zombies and creatures. Players and teammates are often hit by environmental explosions or friendly fire, with blood splattering and dismemberment accompanying the battles. Enemy camps and battlefield environments are depicted with bloodstains and dismembered corpses.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4790K or AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 470
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K or AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 6600XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended

short_description: Join the warriors of Astrovoid and fight to save the universe from invasion! Advance with strategic maneuvers against enemy armies, upgrade your arsenal, and change the course of battle. Freedom is not easily won, but you might be the one to take it back!
supported_languages:
English*, Turkish*, Russian*, Simplified Chinese*, Japanese*
*languages with full audio support
